name: ConformKit – EU Legal Guarantee Notice
author: Andrea Creative Soft

sections.description:
From 27 September 2026, every trader selling goods to consumers in the EU must
display the harmonised notice on the legal guarantee of conformity, in a
prominent manner, in the language of the country where the goods are offered.
Online, it must be shown in colour.

ConformKit displays the official notice as published in the Official Journal.
It does not redraw it, does not translate it and does not write its own legal
text — the notice has no editable element, and a redrawn notice is not the
notice.

What it does

  • Creates a dedicated notice page on activation
  • Shortcode [conformkit_notice] for anywhere else
  • Optional link in the footer
  • Optional reminder on the WooCommerce checkout, classic and block-based
  • Picks the language from your site automatically, including WPML and Polylang
  • Falls back to English when a language is missing — never to an invented notice
  • Links through to the official text of the regulation in the same language
  • All 24 official EU languages, in colour, as required online

What it does not do

  • It does not give legal advice. Responsibility for displaying the notice
    correctly, and for the accuracy of anything you enter, remains with you.
  • It does not decide whether the obligation applies to you. Services are not
    covered, and food and the other cases in Article 3(3) of Directive 2011/83/EU
    are excluded.
  • It does not yet handle the GARAN durability label. That is planned for a
    later release.

Where the notice comes from

The notice is Annex I of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1960, as
published in the Official Journal of the European Union and available on
EUR-Lex in each official language.

Legal

with Decision 2011/833/EU.

ConformKit is an independent product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
sponsored by the European Commission or any institution of the European Union.
sections.faq:
Does this apply to my shop?

The notice applies to traders selling goods — tangible movable items — to
consumers in the EU. Services are not covered, and food and the other cases in
Article 3(3) of Directive 2011/83/EU are excluded. If you are unsure, ask a
lawyer, not a plugin.

Why is the notice an image and not text?

Because Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2025/1960 has no editable element. The
notice is reproduced as published.

Which languages are supported?

All 24 official EU languages, for the notice itself. The plugin interface ships
translated into six and grows through translate.wordpress.org.

Does it work with the new block-based checkout?

Yes. The reminder is added after the checkout block as well as on the classic
checkout, and it is printed only once either way.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • The settings screen script is enqueued instead of printed inline.
  • Translations are left to translate.wordpress.org.

0.3.0

  • The checkout reminder can open the notice in a popup instead of sending the
    customer to another page. Uses the browser’s own dialog element: no library,
    no page builder required.
  • The notice image is only downloaded when the popup is opened.
  • Without JavaScript the link still opens the page, so the notice is always
    reachable.

0.2.0

  • The footer link and the checkout reminder can now show an icon, text, or both.
  • The link can point to a page of your own instead of the page ConformKit creates.
  • Existing sites keep showing exactly what they showed before.

0.1.1

  • The footer link and the checkout reminder load their styles again.
  • The settings screen and every admin screen warn when a site language has no
    notice file and the notice falls back to English.
  • The admin notice names the exact file the notice is read from.

0.1.0

  • First release: the harmonised notice, page, shortcode, footer link and
    WooCommerce checkout reminder.
